description: UKMTO WARNING 071-26 - ATTACK Report Date: Report Time: Issue Date: Source 17 Jun 2026 1610UTC 17 Jun 2026 Company Security Officer UKMTO has received a report of an incident 105NM northeast of Aden, Yemen. A vessel has been approached to within 4 meters and fired upon by 2 skiffs with an unknown number of armed persons on board. The vessel has deployed security team and returned fire. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, while authorities are investigating.
